email_body:
Hi SKROL team,

I saw your SEO/GEO Content role and wanted to reach out. I currently run SEO for client businesses at Episto, where I've helped a client rank #4 on page 1 of Google Turkey for "PDKS" and built ~600 member profile pages for a pharmacists' association. I also freelance, selling AI search visibility and SEO services, and I recently ran a self-funded Google Ads test that earned a 4.57% CTR and 53 clicks for a kids' bike brand.

What draws me to SKROL is the focus on B2B SaaS and AI search. I already work with GEO/AEO, keyword research, and content optimization, and I build my own AI products, so I understand how real users find and stick with a product. I'd love to help run your content engine and support client projects.

I live in Zwijndrecht, near Antwerp, and have my own car, so working with your team in Ghent is easy for me.

Best,
Baver Ok

I built kxp.be single-handedly with WordPress, on-page SEO and GEO for AI search in three languages, and I turn articles and client work into social posts. I follow algorithm updates closely, report on rankings and traffic in GA4 and Search Console, and I am eager to learn content, search and social as one growth engine.

- **4.57% CTR and 53 clicks** from a self-funded Google Ads test in Belgium and the Netherlands for a kids' bike brand: built two Dutch landing pages, chose buyer-intent keywords and presented the results to their team
